scope: Historical evaluator bytes are retained independently from engine source snapshots. Receipt SHA, not the original filename, identifies each execution. All current commands should use the canonical accepted evaluator unless reproducing a historical receipt.
archived_cli_path_note: Archived evaluators derive defaults relative to their file. Always pass explicit --assets-root REPO --protocol REPO/docs/landing-engine/protocol.json --video-dir REPO/video --output-root REPO/runs/landing-engine when executing archived files.
